purpose: Art-direction values for code-drawn continuous network paths. Network is the hero surface element.

forest.notes: Thick living root/vine with bark edge; large forms, no hair-thin tendrils at phone LOD.

volcano.notes: Molten river inside dark crust. Keep crust visible. Glow is restrained and must not define the geometry.

continuity.structural_rule: Renderer draws ONE continuous mathematical path per linked pair. The strip only skins that path.
continuity.edge_rule: Never use two separately capped connector sprites meeting at a hex edge.
continuity.junction_rule: Branch hubs are local dressing only; structural links remain continuous pairwise paths.

lod.under_40_css_px: outline + body only; no decorative leaf/crust chips
lod.40_to_79_css_px: one highlight layer, no tiny decorations
lod.130_plus_css_px: full strip detail, still no micro-noise
